rule: Has at least one resource saying who or what does it
Has a line in and a line out
Has a line that starts it and a line that ends it
Starts with an active verb and names the thing it acts on, specifically enough to tell what data it touches ('Approve the quote', not 'Approval' or 'Do checks')

Its label is an outcome: a completed state naming the thing it is about ('Quote approved by the deal desk'), not an instruction; a bare 'Yes' or 'No' passes only when the box it leaves asks a question
Pass mark: every level must score at least this out of 10
